title: LP1 column balance with section-preserving shuffles
question: Does the fixed 464-word arrangement retain unusually low column-mean variance when each section keeps its own word lengths and occupied slots?
summary: A section-preserving variant retains the low-variance result: 88 of 49,999 constrained shuffles are at least as flat, with plus-one estimate 0.00178. Shared-scale figures compare the two null models.

scope.representation: Archived ciphertext runes, headings and interrupting F retained. Join slash and newline wraps and consecutive pages within a section. Rune runs with internal apostrophes form one word; apostrophes count zero runes. Other non-runes delimit words. Never merge sections.
scope.procedure: Retain the baseline word vector and continuous 29-by-16 layout. Independently shuffle fresh copies within each of the four sections, preserving section slots. Compare integer scores proportional to column-mean variance and derive the constrained expectation exactly.
scope.parameters: 16 columns; 29 words per column; section sizes 45,124,208,87; 49,999 trials; Python random.Random seed 330146; lower tail including ties; (tail_count+1)/50000; threshold 0.05. Baseline arrangement and result were known before this frozen variant.
scope.exclusions: Other widths, section orders, sentence-preserving shuffles, coherent-prose comparisons, sentence removal, grille extraction, carrier matching, original-search multiplicity, independent confirmation, authorial intent and decryption.

finding: The observed score stays 128256. With section distributions and slots preserved, 88 of 49,999 shuffled scores are at or below it (plus-one lower-tail estimate 0.00178). The observed variance is 25.21% of this model’s exact expectation; the unrestricted baseline was 25.15%.
limitations: Previously selected arrangement and known baseline. This is a model-sensitivity comparison, not independent or exploration-adjusted evidence. Both nulls destroy sentence syntax. No intent, grille or decryption claim; human review pending.
next_steps: Any sentence-preserving, alternative-width or section-order comparison needs its own frozen procedure and a selection-aware interpretation.
